comment: Program knowledge for the Firewall Manager. protected: anti-cheat services and game launchers whose rules are never recommended for blocking (outbound blocks on them are flagged 'may break online play'); the game executables of data\games.json are protected too. scriptHosts: LOLBins whose allow rules are a risk. userWritable: path patterns any process running as the user can write to. microsoftPublishers: package publisher IDs of Microsoft (Store and Windows packages). owned: how iG Windows Tuner tags its rules.

protected.name: Steam and Valve networking
protected.reason: Steam downloads, Steam Networking and Steam Datagram Relay carry matchmaking and voice for many games.

protected.name: FACEIT client and anti-cheat
protected.reason: FACEIT refuses matches when its client or anti-cheat cannot connect.

protected.name: Riot Vanguard and Riot Client
protected.reason: VALORANT and League of Legends do not start when Vanguard or the Riot Client is blocked.

protected.name: Easy Anti-Cheat
protected.reason: Games protected by Easy Anti-Cheat kick or refuse players whose anti-cheat cannot reach its servers.

protected.name: BattlEye
protected.reason: BattlEye-protected games disconnect when BattlEye is blocked.

protected.name: Game launchers
protected.reason: Launchers handle sign-in, entitlement checks and updates; blocking them breaks online play.

protected.name: Other anti-cheat (Javelin, RICOCHET, EA Anti-Cheat)
protected.reason: Anti-cheat services must reach their servers or the game refuses to start.
